summary: Discussion of various YouTubers’ last meal choices, including dishes, preferences, and tier rankings. Participants shared and debated various last meal ideas, but no decisions were confirmed. Participants shared and evaluated various last‑meal ideas, focusing on taste, texture, and personal preferences. Participants shared personal last meal preferences and assigned informal tier ratings to each other’s choices, but no formal decisions or action items were made.
minutes: Ryan Treyhan’s last meal: salmon nigiri, hamburger without veggies, root beer, tiramisu.
Guga’s last meal: burger with ketchup only, sushi with wasabi, root beer.
Mark’s last meal: soup dumplings, beef Wellington 2.0, cheese souffle, French macarons, rated A tier.
Jesser’s last meal: grilled cheese burger, smiley potato fries, root beer float, creme brulee French toast, ice cream, rated B tier.
Kai’s last meal: big mac and cheese, lamb chops, greens, sweet tea, cheesecake, rated S tier.
Sam and Colby’s last meal: deviled eggs, ghost pepper pizza, chocolate dirt cake.
Participants presented a range of last meal options, including themed foods, desserts, and drinks.
No consensus or final decision was reached on any meal plan.
No explicit assignments or deadlines were stated.

Participants tasted milanesa, mixed mashed potatoes, Alfajores, chicken fried steak, okra, cheese croquettes, Belgian waffles, breakfast items, ribeye with lobster, crème brûlée, cherry doctor pepper, Boulonnaise pasta, potato gratin, lemonade, and cereal.
They compared flavors, textures, and overall enjoyment, noting strengths and weaknesses of each dish.
They discussed preferences for cooking styles, seasoning, and presentation.
They debated the quality of okra and the suitability of breakfast foods for a last meal.
They considered the impact of side dishes and sauces on overall meal satisfaction.
Participants discussed their ideal last meals and expressed opinions on each other’s selections.
Each person assigned a tier rating (B, C, D) to the others’ meal choices based on personal preference.
No decisions were confirmed or actions assigned during the conversation.

non_decisions.text: Proposal to include crushed-up Oreos for dirt and gummy worms, Mountain Dew drink, and ghost pepper pizza as part of a spooky themed meal
non_decisions.evidence_quote: to make sure it has some crushed-up Oreos for dirt and gummy worms. And finally, for our drink, we would love to do some Mountain Dew, because it looks like ectoplasm.

non_decisions.text: Proposal to replace beef with chicken in Taco Bell orders and add nacho fries, Diablo sauce, or Baja Blast
non_decisions.evidence_quote: First item is the beefy gordita crunch. Replace the beef with chicken. Then you have to put nacho fries on top. Second, the beefy five layer burrito. Replace the beef with chicken. Do not forget the Diablo sauce or the Baja Blast.

non_decisions.text: Proposal for KSI’s last meal: jalapeurized Nigerian rice, special fried rice, KFC chicken drumsticks, strawberry white chocolate cookie, and crime energy drink
non_decisions.evidence_quote: I want to start off with the jalapeurized, Nigerian jalapeurized. Then I want special fried rice from China. The best. And then for my protein, KFC chicken. Three drumsticks. That's it. For dessert, a cookie. Strawberry white chocolate cookie. And for my drink, crime energy, chariot, lemmead.

non_decisions.text: Proposal for Stokes Twins’ last meal: crispy fried chicken drumsticks, buttery scrambled eggs, huge boba, Chinese egg tart
non_decisions.evidence_quote: For our last meal, we would eat crispy fried chicken drumsticks, buttery scrambled eggs, a huge boba, and for dessert, a Chinese egg tart.

non_decisions.text: Proposal for Kari Manani’s last meal: Uruguayan-style beef milanesa with mixed mashed potatoes, new Uruguayan alfajor, fresh squeezed orange juice

non_decisions.text: Dude Perfect is getting beat here for their meal choice
non_decisions.evidence_quote: Dude Perfect choice from a mile away. I'm sure you've seen their trick shot videos, but they also love to hunt, and I'm sure that's why they picked deer. I want to start on the queso because it's an appetizer and there's nothing better. I just burnt my tongue. It's cheesy, slightly spicy, nice crunch. Who doesn't like this? I'd want to take this cheesy gordita crunch and I'd want to dip it into that cheesy skillet queso. Let me make you a bite. What about the Axis deer? Still moving. This is how dude perfect wanted it. Oh, I love deer. Deer are very strong, powerful animals, so there's not a lot of fat in there. It doesn't have all the marbling that a wagyu steak has on it. You know what makes a better Nick? Skillet queso. Yes. Oh, that's going to make it better. I will introduce the fat for you, buddy. That's the method. Backing out and looking at the whole meal here, I do notice there's something missing. A drink and a dessert. And so for that reason, dude perfect is getting beat here.
